title: MA2H Resolve Request (v0.5)
description: Body of POST /v1/messages/{id}/resolve (spec §8.8) — the wire binding for resolving an open ask/task, made interoperable in v0.5 for the inter-agent leg's addressee (spec §6). The caller's identity/authorization and any session presentation ride the credential and the ?session= parameter (spec §8.8, §9.1), never the body. `cancelled` is the §8.4 verb and `expired` is Hub-only, so neither appears here. Value-vs-request validation beyond shape (membership in options[].value, conformance to request.schema) is Hub-enforced (spec §8.8).

resolution.description: The terminal the resolver asserts: answered|declined for an ask, completed|dismissed for a task (verb-match Hub-enforced).

value.description: REQUIRED iff resolution is `answered`: the chosen option value (select/confirm; string) or the input object (input mode), per spec §5.2. MUST NOT appear for any other resolution.

checklist.description: Task resolutions only: the final §5.3 checklist state, carried into the Response. MUST NOT appear for ask resolutions.
